collection.description: Shelling nuts all morning, a villager starts making up a song: keep singing, or stop when someone looks.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has been shelling nuts all morning. It is the most boring job on Isola, and (subject.he/she) has done it for so long (subject.his/her) fingers have gone numb. To pass the time, (subject.he/she) starts making up a song: "One for the basket, one for the pile, one for me when nobody's looking..."

a__fx.name: Answer A
a__fx.text: The people working nearby start joining in. Somebody adds a verse about a crab who stole the nuts. Somebody else adds a verse about the crab getting caught. By lunchtime the whole group has a song with fourteen verses and a dance in the middle, and the nuts are all shelled. Nobody is quite sure how.

b__fx.name: Answer B
b__fx.text: (friend) looks over, eyebrows raised, and (subject) stops singing, embarrassed. The shelling goes on in silence. After a while, from the other end of the row, (subject) hears someone humming the tune, very quietly. "One for the basket..." (subject) grins and keeps shelling.
